proposed_comments.title: Add provider-mapping coverage for Anthropic
proposed_comments.body:
### Add provider-mapping coverage for Anthropic

**Severity:** `medium`

Please add focused unit coverage proving that the Anthropic service type resolves to the Anthropic provider through the provider factory and that its configured endpoint/model settings are preserved. The new provider is wired through several mapping and registration layers, so a regression in one of those mappings could make the feature appear in settings while failing at execution time.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The requested coverage spans the provider registry, factory, and settings mapping layers and is not safely represented by one current upstream diff range.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The requested coverage spans the provider registry, factory, and settings mapping layers and is not safely represented by one current upstream diff range.

confidence.rationale: The fresh Copilot pass identified the missing automated proof across the newly added Anthropic registration and provider-mapping path.

proposed_comments.title: Cover enterprise-policy enforcement at execution time
proposed_comments.body:
### Cover enterprise-policy enforcement at execution time

**Severity:** `high`

Please add regression coverage for the execution path when the Anthropic provider is disabled by enterprise policy, including an already-configured provider. The policy check must prevent the request from being sent even when settings or a saved action still reference Anthropic, and the test should verify the user-facing failure path.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required assertion crosses policy evaluation, provider resolution, and request execution; no single current RIGHT-side diff range is a safe apply-ready anchor.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required assertion crosses policy evaluation, provider resolution, and request execution; no single current RIGHT-side diff range is a safe apply-ready anchor.

confidence.rationale: Execution-time policy enforcement protects against stale or externally modified settings and was explicitly retained as the remaining substantive Copilot recommendation.
